tools.name: hive_list_workspaces
tools.description: List the Hive workspaces the API key can access. Call this first to get a workspace id. GET /workspaces.

tools.name: hive_list_projects
tools.description: List the projects in a workspace. Set archived to true to list archived projects. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

tools.name: hive_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by id, including its dates, color, sharing and budget fields. GET /projects/{projectId}.

tools.name: hive_list_workspace_users
tools.description: List the members of a workspace (cursor paginated). Use the user ids in action assignees. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/users.

tools.name: hive_list_teams
tools.description: List the teams in a workspace (cursor paginated). GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/teams.

tools.name: hive_list_labels
tools.description: List the labels in a workspace (cursor paginated). Labels tag actions. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/labels.

tools.name: hive_list_agile_sprints
tools.description: List the agile sprints in a workspace (cursor paginated). GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/agile-sprints.

tools.name: hive_list_actions
tools.description: List actions (Hive's tasks) in a workspace, optionally for one project or a deadline range (yyyy-mm-dd). Cursor paginated. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/actions.

tools.name: hive_search_actions
tools.description: Search actions by title text in a workspace. Returns an array (not cursor pagination); use limit and skip. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/actions/search.

tools.name: hive_get_action
tools.description: Get one action (task) by id, with its title, status, deadline, assignees and custom fields. GET /actions/{actionId}.

tools.name: hive_list_subactions
tools.description: List the subactions (child tasks) of one action (cursor paginated). GET /actions/{actionId}/subactions.

tools.name: hive_list_action_comments
tools.description: List the comments on one action (cursor paginated). GET /actions/{actionId}/comments.

tools.name: hive_list_tables
tools.description: List the tables (Hive data tables) in a workspace that the API key can read. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tables.

tools.name: hive_list_table_records
tools.description: List the records of one table as flat rows (for reporting). Use offset or the after cursor to page. GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tables/{tableId}/records.

tools.name: hive_create_action
tools.description: Create a new action (task) in a workspace. Give a title; the project, description and assignees are optional. POST /actions.

tools.name: hive_update_action
tools.description: Change fields of one action. Pass only the fields to change, named as Hive names them (for example title, description, deadline). PUT /actions/{actionId}.

tools.name: hive_create_action_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to one action. POST /actions/{actionId}/comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: hive_list_action_comments · Private data: hive_list_workspaces, hive_list_tables, hive_list_table_records · Public sink: hive_create_action, hive_create_action_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: hive_list_action_comments · Private data: hive_list_workspaces, hive_list_tables, hive_list_table_records · Public sink: hive_create_action, hive_create_action_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
